title: Himekishi-sama no Himo
englishTitle: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight
title_english: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight

synonyms: He Is a Kept Man for Princess Knight.
alternative_titles.en: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight

synopsis:
The Dungeon City is a wicked place filled with crime, debauchery, and death. Its one shining light is Arwin, the beautiful Crimson Princess Knight. She and her brave party of adventurers descend into the dungeon at the city's center, seeking a legendary treasure with the power to rebuild the princess's fallen kingdom. Many yearn to be by her side, but that spot is already taken by Matthew, a man despised by all in town as a cowardly weakling. Everyone thinks he is scum who just spends her hard-earned money on booze, women, and gambling. No one in the city—not even the princess knight— knows what Matthew is truly capable of.

(Source: Yen Press)
synopsis_es:
Dungeon City es un lugar perverso lleno de crimen, libertinaje y muerte. Su única luz brillante es Arwin, la hermosa Princesa Caballero Carmesí. Ella y su valiente grupo de aventureros descienden a la mazmorra en el centro de la ciudad, en busca de un tesoro legendario con el poder de reconstruir el reino caído de la princesa. Muchos anhelan estar a su lado, pero ese lugar ya lo ocupa Matthew, un hombre despreciado por todos en la ciudad como un cobarde y débil. Todo el mundo piensa que es una escoria que simplemente gasta el dinero que tanto le costó ganar en alcohol, mujeres y juegos de azar. Nadie en la ciudad, ni siquiera la princesa caballero, sabe de lo que Matthew es realmente capaz.

(Fuente: Prensa del yen)
